# JetBrains Mono

- **Version:** 2.305, Regular (TTF).
- **Source:** <https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono>, `fonts/ttf/JetBrainsMono-Regular.ttf`, downloaded 2026-09-26.
- **Copyright:** 2020 The JetBrains Mono Project Authors.
- **License:** SIL Open Font License 1.1, see `OFL.txt`. Allowed for fonts by ADR 0036.
- **Use:** code, the console and numbers that must line up (`engine_text::fonts::JETBRAINS_MONO`); in the UI stack, the arrows, math and key symbols (→ ≤ ✓ ⌘ ⇧ ⏎) that Noto Sans lacks.
- **Changes:** none (unmodified).
